chunks: Leave Me to those who deny, the lovers of ease and comfort; and bear with them for a while.

key_terms.أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ: Lovers of ease / Possessors of comfort
key_terms.قَلِيلًا: For a while / A short time
key_terms.وَمَهِّلْهُمْ: And grant them respite / Bear with them

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Leave Me to those who deny' mean in Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'tadhallul' (gradual decline), where divine patience allows the arrogant to become entrenched in their denial before punishment strikes. It serves as a warning that worldly prosperity for disbelievers is not a sign of divine favor but a prelude to their ultimate ruin, a theme central to the narrative of the Prophet's mission in Mecca.
